messages:
From: Sara Manzano <sara@neptuneanalytics.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18 09:05 PDT
Subject: Neptune + Redwood joint offering — marketplace listing inquiry

Hi Vivek —

Thanks again for the intro at last week's partners forum. Neptune Analytics builds real-time analytics for LLM-driven apps; several of our customers have asked for a bundled offering that pairs our instrumentation with Redwood's hosted inference. We're exploring publishing a joint listing on AWS and GCP marketplaces and want to understand:

- What evidence / artifacts Redwood needs to list an integrated offering (billing SKUs, metering, security doc pointers)
- Options and timeline for a co-sell enablement (AWS ISV co-sell, GCP partner activation)
- Any commercial/sku constraints we should expect from your marketplace flows (rev share, minimum commitments)

Target for a public listing: late Nov. Curious what the minimal path-to-listing looks like if we aim for a Nov 30 launch. I've copied our contracts lead (contracts@neptuneanalytics.com) for procurement questions.

Attached: traffic_estimates.csv (sample weekly usage by customer).

Thanks — happy to jump on a call this week.

—Sara
Sara Manzano
Head of Partnerships, Neptune Analytics
https://neptuneanalytics.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Manzano <sara@neptuneanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18 11:12 PDT
Subject: Re: Neptune + Redwood joint offering — marketplace listing inquiry

Hi Sara — great to meet you (virtually). Excited about the fit — there are two pragmatic paths for a combined listing: (1) a co-listed offering where Neptune is the publisher and Redwood provides a listed Marketplace integration (we surface a Redwood-managed SKU), or (2) a joint offering with Redwood as a reseller/publisher in specific clouds. Each has different evidence and billing flows.

High level next steps I recommend:
- Fill a short mutual action plan (MAP) we use for marketplace launches (I attached a checklist you can start with).
- Ben can map the SKU/metering story (metering shim vs. direct metering) — Ben/Olga, can you take the technical lead here?
- We need SOC2 docs + a short security evidence binder for AWS/GCP certification. Naomi on our side will own evidence collection.
- Commercial ask: confirm target price bands and expected monthly usage so we can size SKUs.

I've attached: neptune-market-access-checklist.xlsx (starter MAP + docs checklist).

If Nov 30 is the target, practical timeline: MAP signed and contracts by Oct 29, tech validation/telemetry by Nov 10, marketplace submissions Nov 12–15, certification/final listing Nov 20–30 (contingent on cloud review times).

I'll schedule a 30-min sync with the team for tomorrow afternoon.

Best,
Vivek
Head of Cloud Partnerships — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Sara Manzano <sara@neptuneanalytics.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-19 08:37 PDT
Subject: Re: Neptune + Redwood joint offering — marketplace listing inquiry

Sara / Vivek — looping in a few technical/commercial notes from the marketplace ops side. Quick proposals and open questions: 

Proposed SKU & metering approach (draft):
- sku_redwood_inference: per-1k-token block (Redwood handles inference tokens); price band A/B/C by monthly volume
- sku_neptune_signal: per-inference-session metric (Neptune provides signal consumption telemetry)
- Combined bundle sku_neptune_redwood_bundle: bundled SKU for customers who buy integrated offering

Metering options:
- Preferred: Neptune emits usage events to a metering shim (small SDK) that posts aggregated usage to Redwood-managed ingestion. This keeps billing centralized for co-listed offerings.
- Alternate: Cloud-native metering (GCP marketplace metering service) — requires additional telemetry hook and review.

Open items for you (Sara):
- Confirm rough monthly token estimate (sample file attached helped) and expected percent of customers who will want bundle vs standalone.
- Any constraints on revenue share (Neptune legal) or minimum monthly commitment?

Operational asks from Redwood:
- SOC2 report (or bridging attestation) + data handling summary
- Contact for your engineering lead to coordinate telemetry SDK integration

Tracking: HubSpot deal HS-83421 (link: https://hubspot.redwood.example/deal/HS-83421). I attached sku-mapping-draft.xlsx with the proposed SKU IDs for review.

Ben
Director, Partner Integrations — Redwood Inference
From: Sara Manzano <sara@neptuneanalytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@neptuneanalytics.com
Date: 2026-10-20 14:22 PDT
Subject: Re: Neptune + Redwood joint offering — marketplace listing inquiry

Thanks Ben — this is very helpful. A few quick responses: 
- The traffic_estimates.csv we attached earlier includes token columns; rough monthly token estimate for pilot customers is ~45M tokens/month and 12 pilot accounts likely to opt-in for bundle.
- Revenue share: Neptune prefers a gross-split model (proportional to usage) rather than a minimum commitment for the pilot — legal is on this thread.
- Engineering contact: cc'ing our lead, Carlos Vega (carlos@neptuneanalytics.com), to coordinate the metering shim integration.

We're okay with the proposed SKU naming, but request the bundle sku have a lower entry price to encourage trials. Attached is our traffic_estimates.csv.

For MAP / contracts: please send DocuSign when ready; we'll aim to return a signed MAP within 24–48 hours.

—Sara

- Pilot usage: ~45M tokens/month across ~12 pilot customers (Sara)
- SKU plan: use sku_redwood_inference, sku_neptune_signal, sku_neptune_redwood_bundle (Ben to finalize pricing bands)
- Commercial: Neptune prefers gross-split for pilot; legal will confirm details via DocuSign

Next steps (owners & deadlines)
- Oct 29: MAP + basic SOW signed (Vivek to send DocuSign). Link: https://docusign.net/envelope/123abc
- Nov 10: Telemetry & metering shim validated in staging (Ben + Carlos)
- Nov 15: Marketplace submission (AWS & GCP) (Olga + partners ops)
- Nov 20–30: Cloud review & certification window; target public listing Nov 30

Attachments to send with MAP: neptune-market-access-checklist.xlsx, sku-mapping-draft.xlsx, Neptune SOC2 attestation (Sara/legal to provide).

Action: Ben, can you draft the final SKU price bands and send updated sku-mapping-draft.xlsx by EOD Oct 27? Olga, please confirm expected GCP metering review lead time so we can surface any gating items.

I'll schedule the 30-min enablement call for Oct 26 at 10am PT; invite pending.

Thanks — Vivek
